name: Fujicolor Pro 160S
source: Fuji Photo Film Co., Ltd., FUJICOLOR PRO 160 S PROFESSIONAL Product Information Bulletin, Ref. No. AF3-174E (EIGI-05.1, 2005-01)

notes.characteristic: Exposure daylight, 1/125 s, process C-41, Status M densitometry. No reference log exposure for a normally exposed neutral is printed.
notes.sensitivity: Process C-41, Status M, density 1.0 above D-min; relative sensitivity (log) = reciprocal of the exposure (J/cm2) required. Only a 1.0 log bracket is printed, so 0.0 and 1.0 are the bracketing gridlines (relative, not absolute). A fourth, dashed cyan-sensitive layer is also plotted; it is dropped (null) because the model uses three layers.
notes.dye_density: Spectral diffuse density, typical densities for a mid-scale neutral subject and for D-min (no per-dye curves published).

grain.note: Diffuse RMS granularity value; micro-densitometer measurement aperture 48 µm diameter, sample density +1.0 above minimum density. Based on Fujifilm measurements; not comparable with colour reversal film.
